text:
renata_fin: Heads-up \/ vendor 'Sao Paulo DataWorks' submitted invoice INV-BR-7723. They withheld 5% ISS and are asking us to gross-up per the services agreement. Invoice in bill.com.
carlos_sales: link to bill: https:\/\/app.bill.com\/inv\/BR-7723

renata_fin: Contract clause quote requested. Do we have precedent for reimbursing ISS withholding? Vendor says municipal law forces withholding at source.

leo_tax_br: Quick tax note: ISS (imposto sobre serviços) is municipal. In many municipalities payer must withhold and remit. If contract has gross-up clause we typically reimburse, but we need vendor docs: NFS-e (nota fiscal de serviço) showing RPS/ID, CNPJ, and guia de recolhimento (comprovante de recolhimento do ISS). Also check if IRRF applies for this service (possible small withholding).

ap_ar: From AP side: if we gross-up, we pay vendor the gross amount and remit the withheld tax to municipality. Example JE (BRL): invoice 10,000 BRL, ISS withheld 500 BRL => we pay 10,000 BRL to vendor and record WHT payable 500 BRL until remitted. If vendor already retained 500, we'll do a top-up 500.

carlos_sales: Vendor uploaded a scanned NFS-e but it's missing the guia. They say municipality will issue DAR\/guia later. They want advance reimbursement now.

leo_tax_br: We cannot reimburse without proof of withholding\/remittance. Acceptable: NFS-e + guia de recolhimento or bank proof of payment to municipality. If they can't provide, Legal approval required to take risk.

renata_fin: Contract excerpt: "Customer will gross-up payments to ensure Provider receives amounts net of any required withholding taxes." So legal language is present.

ap_ar: Operational ask: if Legal approves taking a risk, we can process conditional reimbursement and hold a receivable against vendor until proof is provided. Preferable to wait for docs.

carlos_sales: Vendor pushed back - cashflow issue. As a compromise can we advance 50% of gross-up pending docs?

leo_tax_br: Not without a signed indemnity and proof of identity (CNPJ + authorized signatory). Also need to record in tax log.

renata_fin: I'll ask vendor (cc: accounts@saupaulodataworks.com) for NFS-e with RPS ID + guia or bank payment screenshot + CNPJ and signatory. If they provide within 3 business days AP will process.

ap_ar: Please tag as cost center 'Partner Rebates - LATAM' and mark bill.com status 'tax-docs-pending'.

carlos_sales: pinged vendor for docs.

renata_fin: thanks all :thumbsup:

billing-bot: Invoice INV-BR-7723 uploaded by sao-paulo-ops at 2025-06-04 13:22 BRT.
